## Biography

Rackham's Peak is a remote deep-space location that serves as a fleet carrier bottleneck in the galaxy's sparsely starred reaches. In October 3312, Brewer Corporation named it among the first sites where its "jump satellites" would be deployed to let multiple fleet carriers traverse systems with no planetary bodies.
